page_title: VEN 0-1 INT | Venezia v Inter 12/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+3' Federico Dimarco (Inter) commits a rough challenge and Marco Piccinini blows his whistle for a foul.
90+2' Joel Pohjanpalo (Venezia) latched on to a fine crossfield pass on the edge of the box and lashed a shot directly at the middle of the goal, where the keeper stood ready.
90+1' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by John Yeboah (Venezia). Marco Piccinini saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
88' Eusebio Di Francesco prepares a substitution. Francesco Zampano is replaced by Christian Gytkjaer (Venezia).
88' Substitution. Cheick Conde (Venezia) has come on for Hans Nicolussi Caviglia.
85' The statistic for corner kicks – 4:5.
85' Federico Dimarco (Inter) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.
83' The substitution has been made. Federico Dimarco (Inter) has replaced Nicolo Barella.
82' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Francesco Zampano (Venezia), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
80' Marco Piccinini shows a yellow card to Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Venezia) for a tough tackle.
78' Good movement by Alessandro Bastoni (Inter), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor.
76' Simone Inzaghi has decided to make a change. Benjamin Pavard (Inter) replaces Denzel Dumfries.
76' That's the end of the game for Lautaro Martinez, who is replaced by Marko Arnautovic (Inter).
75' The attendance is 12048.

75' Davide Frattesi (Inter) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away.

74' What a chance that is! Gianluca Busio (Venezia) wastes a huge opportunity as he receives a beautiful pass on the edge of the box and fires towards the net. Unfortunately for him, he only hits the right post!
73' The Inter players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
70' A substitution has been made. Issa Doumbia goes off and Bjarki Bjarkason (Venezia) comes on.
70' Eusebio Di Francesco decides to make a substitution. Gaetano Oristanio will be replaced by John Yeboah (Venezia).
69' The ball is crossed into the box and Lautaro Martinez (Inter) reacts quickest to send a shot flying towards the middle of the goal, but Filip Stankovic gets a glove on it to thwart him.
68' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 4:15.
67' The resulting set piece from Inter is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

67' Davide Frattesi (Inter) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot low towards the middle of the goal. However, Filip Stankovic anticipates the shot and makes an easy save. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Inter will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
66' A crossfield pass from Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) fails to find any of his teammates.
64' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) is clearly in an offside position after the ball is played through to him and the linesman raises his flag.
63' Simone Inzaghi has decided to substitute Kristjan Asllani and he is replaced by Davide Frattesi (Inter).
63' The referee allows time for a substitution. Mehdi Taremi will be replaced by Marcus Thuram (Inter).
61' Inter failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
60' Carlos Augusto (Inter) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear. The ball is out of play. Inter win a corner kick.
59' Ridgeciano Haps (Venezia) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
58' Gaetano Oristanio (Venezia) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Marco Piccinini blows for a foul.
57' The foul by Denzel Dumfries (Inter) was seen by Marco Piccinini who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
55' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) is caught offside after the linesman raises his flag.
54' Mehdi Taremi (Inter) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
50' Issa Doumbia (Venezia) collects a rebound and his promising attempt heads towards the middle of the goal, but Yann Sommer keeps it out with an amazing save.
50' Venezia quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
49' The resulting corner from Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Venezia) is cleared by the defence. Venezia will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
49' Jay Idzes (Venezia) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety. The referee blows his whistle, Venezia are awarded a corner kick.
46' Gaetano Oristanio (Venezia) shows off his amazing technique to get to the edge of the box by himself. He pulls the trigger but sends the ball into the stands. Nice run, but poor finish!
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
45' Kristjan Asllani (Inter) decides to have a go at goal from the edge of the box, but the wall jumps as one and blocks the free kick. Danger averted!
44' Francesco Zampano (Venezia) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
44' Francesco Zampano (Venezia) commits a rough foul. Marco Piccinini stops the game and makes a call. Inter are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
41' Kristjan Asllani (Inter) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
39' Mehdi Taremi (Inter) takes a mid-range shot, but the ball sails high over the bar.
37' The resulting corner, taken by Kristjan Asllani (Inter), comes to nothing.
37' Inter take a short corner kick.

36' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) receives a slide-rule pass inside the box and has just the keeper to beat. His shot towards the bottom left corner lacks power and Filip Stankovic easily makes the save. The ball goes out for a corner. Inter can continue in their attacking effort.
35' Venezia keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
33' Carlos Augusto (Inter) tries to score from mid-range after collecting a rebound, but his shot lacks accuracy and sails high over the bar.
31' Dangerous play by Mikael Egill Ellertsson (Venezia). Marco Piccinini blows his whistle for a foul.
28' Venezia take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
28' Joel Pohjanpalo (Venezia) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked. The referee points to the corner flag and Venezia will take a corner.
26' Venezia work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
26' Richie Sagrado is being substituted because of an injury. Eusebio Di Francesco sends Ridgeciano Haps (Venezia) on the pitch.
25' The game is interrupted now, Richie Sagrado (Venezia) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
25' Marin Sverko (Venezia) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out. The ball goes behind for a corner. Venezia will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
23' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) is penalised for a foul. Marco Piccinini had a clear view and blows his whistle.
21' Mehdi Taremi (Inter) lets fly with a crisp shot from inside the box after picking up a lofted pass from Denzel Dumfries, but the ball goes just over the bar.
18' Here comes the VAR verdict: Referee Marco Piccinini signals that there was no offside and the goal stands! The Inter players celebrate.
17' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible offside. The Inter players aren’t happy.
16' 0 - 1 Goal! Matteo Darmian (Inter) fires the rebound into the bottom right corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 0:1.
14' Today's referee Marco Piccinini rightly decides to book Gaetano Oristanio (Venezia) for his harsh tackle.
13' Piotr Zielinski (Inter) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
13' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) fires the ball from distance, but it's blocked by a defender. Good work from Inter as they win a corner.
10' Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.
6' Kristjan Asllani (Inter) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, but it is straight at Filip Stankovic.
6' Joel Pohjanpalo (Venezia) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Marco Piccinini blows his whistle for a foul. Free kick. Inter will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
5' A superb shot by Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Venezia) after a mid-range free kick! His attempt, however, flies just over the crossbar.
4' The sound of the whistle has almost been drowned out in the deafening atmosphere of this match. Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Venezia) is setting the ball up for a free kick from mid-range.

3' Kristjan Asllani (Inter) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Marco Piccinini no option but to blow his whistle. That's a free kick to Venezia.
2' Inter keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
1' The match has just started.
The players are on the pitch and Venezia will have the kick-off.
Marco Piccinini got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
